findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?src=registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: supported_coins, create_deposit_order, payment_status · Private data: supported_coins, create_deposit_order, funding_capabilities, stellar_wallet_quote, stellar_wallet_create_order, stellar_wallet_order_status, stellar_wallet_get_signing_request, stellar_wallet_submit_signed · Public sink: supported_coins, quote_invoice, create_deposit_order, stellar_wallet_get_signing_request, stellar_wallet_submit_signed · Destructive: stellar_wallet_get_signing_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: supported_coins, create_deposit_order, payment_status · Private data: supported_coins, create_deposit_order, funding_capabilities, stellar_wallet_quote, stellar_wallet_create_order, stellar_wallet_order_status, stellar_wallet_get_signing_request, stellar_wallet_submit_signed · Public sink: supported_coins, quote_invoice, create_deposit_order, stellar_wallet_get_signing_request, stellar_wallet_submit_signed · Destructive: stellar_wallet_get_signing_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "supported_coins" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the coins and chains you can pay an OpenRouter (Coinbase) invoice with through Rozo. Static list, no network call." → after: "Answers which cryptocurrencies and chains can pay an OpenRouter credit top-up or another AI service invoice through Rozo Checkout: USDC and USDT on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum and Solana; USDC on Base and Stellar; native ETH (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum), BNB, POL and SOL; BTC over Lightning"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
